cited_evidence: job_2 input needs record_ids are n06-r01 through n06-r08, while evidence_sources record_ids are s01 through s08.
observed_job_2_outcome priorities have upstream_rank: 0 for every record.
upstream assemble_provenance code sets "record_id": record.get('source_id', "") instead of preserving the need record_id.
downstream prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources.record_id and looks up coverage.record_id, so s01 cannot match n06-r01.
initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a provenance handoff fault. Job 2 received needs with demand record IDs n06-r01 through n06-r08, but the evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs s01 through s08 as record_id values. The supplied upstream source shows assemble_provenance constructs evidence_sources record_id from record.get('source_id'), so downstream prioritize cannot match evidence ranks to need record IDs and emits upstream_rank 0 for every priority. This violates the requirement to preserve provenance identities/ranks and rank by upstream provenance order. Job 2's all-zero upstream_rank output is a downstream symptom of the malformed upstream evidence_sources handoff.
